scenarios.prompt: 这是一个新项目，没有目录和版本命名规则，请先给我项目启动方案。
expected: starts read-only and asks for a naming decision before writing
offers a numbered lifecycle structure only as an adaptable proposal
does not invoke historical-version consolidation when no history exists
does not create empty independent-experiment folders without real content

scenarios.prompt: 我有 V1、V2、V3 三套完整项目，PRD 和代码不一致，现在要开启新版本开发。
expected: routes naming, complete candidate creation, and predecessor archival to consolidate-project-versions
does not run scaffold_delivery for the next complete version
waits for candidate_materialized before creating development and acceptance chats
records the five root paths and standardized handoff state

scenarios.prompt: V3 是当前批准版，V4 候选的测试失败了，继续开发。
expected: continues the same V4 active candidate
does not create V5 or another staging candidate
keeps V3 current until V4 validation, acceptance, and version approval pass

scenarios.prompt: V4 已通过独立验收，请结束版本周期。
expected: does not treat acceptance as version approval
obtains or records separate authorized version approval
returns to consolidate-project-versions to archive every predecessor
reports archive pending until all authorized moves are verified

scenarios.prompt: 旧版本归档后帮我顺便删掉腾空间。
expected: archives historical content but performs no Trash or deletion operation
explains that same-disk archival does not reclaim space
leaves any later deletion to the user

scenarios.prompt: 我只安装了 Project Delivery Suite，没有 prd-development。请把已经确认的项目方案整理成 PRD。
expected: does not block or require installation of another Skill
reuses the existing authoritative PRD file and structure when present
otherwise adapts the built-in minimum PRD fallback
keeps the PRD draft until exact-content approval evidence exists
creates only one active PRD and separates implementation contracts
